disclosure: Timing deviation: As noted in FSD section 10.3 and docs/STATUS.md / docs/HANDOFF_WS1_WS2.md, core token-optimization switches (TO-01 through TO-09) and initial test harnesses were implemented in milestones M1-M3 prior to benchmark task suite freezing. This frozen suite serves as the held-out evaluation baseline for all subsequent comparisons and ablations.

tasks.title: Boolean flag toggle handling with custom prefix
tasks.prompt: Fix an issue in Click argument parsing where boolean option flags with default True do not correctly toggle when passed --no-<flag> with custom prefix.

tasks.title: Case-insensitive choice matching
tasks.prompt: Add a case_sensitive parameter (default True) to click.Choice so case-insensitive matching can be enabled for choices.

tasks.title: Refactor help option parameter resolution
tasks.prompt: Refactor help_option parameter building in click.decorators to use _make_option_name helper instead of duplicated prefix string manipulation.

tasks.title: Test bash completion with spaced values
tasks.prompt: Add test cases covering bash completion when parameter values contain spaces and quoted delimiters in tests/test_shell_completion.py.

tasks.title: Prompt default resolution on empty input
tasks.prompt: Fix click.prompt so an empty input line returns the default value without raising Abort when default is empty string.

tasks.title: Hidden command support in Group listing
tasks.prompt: Ensure commands registered on a group with hidden=True are omitted from the formatted command listing in help output.

tasks.title: DebugUndefined chained filter attribute access
tasks.prompt: Fix DebugUndefined in jinja2.runtime so accessing missing attributes in chained filter expressions raises UndefinedError with attribute name instead of raw KeyError.

tasks.title: Unique filter attribute parameter support
tasks.prompt: Enhance the unique filter in jinja2.filters to accept an optional attribute argument to deduplicate a list of dicts/objects by a specific property.

tasks.title: Compiler CodeGenerator AST visitor method caching
tasks.prompt: Refactor dynamic method lookup in CodeGenerator.visit to cache node handler methods to eliminate repetitive getattr dispatch calls.

tasks.title: Async loop control test suite
tasks.prompt: Add comprehensive async test cases in tests/test_async.py verifying loop.index and loop.nextitem behavior inside async for blocks.

tasks.title: Markup subclass XML auto-escaping
tasks.prompt: Ensure that subclasses of Markup or SafeString are not double-escaped when passed through escape or custom filters.

tasks.title: Slice filter negative indexing support
tasks.prompt: Update do_slice filter in jinja2.filters to handle negative step or slice boundaries without throwing IndexError.

tasks.title: Preserve query encoding in res.redirect
tasks.prompt: Fix res.redirect in lib/response.js to ensure query string parameters with spaces or unicode symbols remain correctly percent-encoded when resolving relative URLs.

tasks.title: Header appending support via res.appendHeader
tasks.prompt: Add res.appendHeader(field, val) in lib/response.js that appends to existing response headers as an array or comma-separated list.

tasks.title: Router path regex pattern compilation caching
tasks.prompt: Refactor path parameter parsing in lib/router/layer.js to avoid redundant regex recompilation for unchanged route path patterns.

tasks.title: Empty request body handling tests
tasks.prompt: Add tests in test/req.body.js verifying that empty strings and whitespace-only request payloads are handled properly by middleware without unhandled promise rejections.

tasks.title: Sub-app router mount path trailing slash resolution
tasks.prompt: Fix routing issue in lib/router/index.js where mounting a sub-app at a path ending with / fails to match root routes on the sub-app.

tasks.title: Custom status fallback messaging in res.sendStatus
tasks.prompt: Allow res.sendStatus in lib/response.js to accept custom HTTP status codes and provide a sensible fallback message if no default status message exists in http.STATUS_CODES.
